source_text: Ὁ ὁμολογῶν, ὅτι θεός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός, ταπεινώσας ἑαυτὸν μέλλει σχεῖν τὸν Χριστὸν ὁμολογοῦντα περὶ αὐτοῦ τῷ πατρί, ὅτι γνήσιός ἐστι δοῦλος.
pass_a_gloss: The confessing, that God is the Christ, having-humbled himself is-about to-have the Christ confessing about him to the Father, that genuine he-is servant.
pass_b_english: The one who confesses that Christ is God, having humbled himself, will have Christ confessing about him to the Father that he is a genuine servant (Matthew 10:32).
